"""Docstrings the rule must leave alone."""


def status_codes():
    """Refused with 404 when unknown and 409 when held."""


def standalone_route():
    """Calls ``POST /api/things`` and prints the reply."""


def local_api():
    """A thin client of its local API."""


def ordinary_client():
    """A client of the hub that never prints a method."""


def near_miss():
    """A client offering POSTING of /api/things, and a client of GETTER /x."""


def method_without_route():
    """A client of POST requests."""
